description: Renders a Phosphor icon with size and color set through class names.
overview:
`Icon` takes a Phosphor icon component in `as` and maps `size-*` classes to its size and `text-*` classes to its color. It defaults to `size-5 text-label`.

Icons inherit text and icon classes from their parent, so an `Icon` inside a `Button`, `Badge` or menu item picks up the right size and color without extra classes. Components provide these through `IconClassContext`.
usage:
Pass the icon component, not an element: `<Icon as={HeartIcon} />`. Override the size and color with `className`, such as `size-6 text-danger`. Other Phosphor props, such as `weight` and `mirrored`, are passed through.

Wrap a subtree in `IconClassContext.Provider` to set default classes for the icons inside your own components.

parts.IconClassContext: Context that supplies default icon classes.

accessibility: - Icons have no label of their own. When an icon is the only content of a pressable, give the pressable an `accessibilityLabel`.
notes: - The default color is the `text-label` token, so icons follow light and dark mode with the system appearance.
